2121242249979625571.en_summary: PPI comes in cooler than expected – is the year-end rally back on? Cooler-than-expected PPI gives bulls hope for year-end rally. After sharp correction and rebound, question if sustainable recovery or oversold bounce. $SPY fell from ~$781 to $732, recovered to $763, key test at $753 support. $QQQ from ~$762 to $647, rebound to $695-696 resistance, $679 key support. $NVDA reached weekly support after Jensen departure, high-volume hammer, rebound toward $171 gap-fill, suggest trim near lows. $TSLA-$SPCX takeover rumors heating up, possible deal around $420. Deployed 25% of Blood in the Street Account during correction.
2121242249979625571.zh_summary: PPI 低於預期 – 年底反彈是否回歸？低於預期的 PPI 給予多頭年底反彈希望。在急劇修正和反彈後，問題是可持續恢復還是超賣反彈。$SPY 從約 $781 跌至 $732，恢復至 $763，關鍵測試 $753 支撑。$QQQ 從約 $762 至 $647，反彈至 $695-696 阻力，$679 關鍵支撑。$NVDA 在 Jensen 離職後達到週線支撑，高成交量錘頭，反彈向 $171 缺口填充，建議近低點修剪。$TSLA-$SPCX 收購傳聞升溫，可能交易約 $420。在修正期間部署 Blood in the Street 帳戶的 25%。

2121241748890394882.en_summary: Lots of earnings blowups happening (cost inflation finally hitting P&Ls?) $FLO - miss + guidance cut + volumes still falling. $PAL - levered acquisition + earnings collapsed. $CTVA - sales falling + guidance cut. $ADIG - first post-spin earnings + guidance cut = down 50%.
2121241748890394882.zh_summary: 大量業績爆雷發生（成本通臀終於衝擊損益表？）$FLO - 未達標 + 指引下調 + 銷量仍下降。$PAL - 槓桿收購 + 業績崩潰。$CTVA - 銷售下降 + 指引下調。$ADIG - 首次分拆後業績 + 指引下調 = 下跌 50%。

2121241249047081136.en_summary: All 8 Globalstar satellites built on $RKLB buses have passed their initial tests in orbit which is a huge step given that $AMZN ~$12B acquisition depends on replacement constellation meeting deployment milestones. These satellites are also destined for the network behind $AAPL Emergency SOS so Rocket Lab is already part of the supply chain ahead of Amazon’s D2D expansion.
2121241249047081136.zh_summary: 所有 8 顆基於 $RKLB 巴士建造的 Globalstar 衛星已通過軌道上的初始測試，這是重大一步，因為 $AMZN 約 120 億美元收購取決於替代星座滿足部署里程碑。這些衛星也將用於 $AAPL 緊急 SOS 背後的網絡，因此 Rocket Lab 已在 Amazon D2D 擴張前成為供應鏈一部分。
